# Provenance

- Source: project-original integer-delay circuit timing model, fixed `2026-10-26-static-timing-v0.1.2`.
- License: project public release license pending owner decision; all graphs synthetic.
- Adaptation: none from external benchmarks. Harbor layout follows the existing local project convention.
- Distinct mechanism: unlike the prior logic simulation family, this task never propagates Boolean values; it analyzes min/max path arrival, reconvergence and setup/hold clock-pair constraints.
- Capabilities: deterministic graph order, domain-indexed path extrema, tie-breaking, missing-constraint status and slack audit.
- Natural parallelism: graph rules, path propagation, constraint formulas and audit can be developed as separate interfaces, then integrated; node count is data volume, not Agent work nodes. No forced DAG.
- Network/resources: offline logic, Python standard library, 2 CPU, 2 GiB, no GPU; `allow_internet=true` by explicit user authorization for new66–100 formal tasks and free oracle copies; business logic remains offline.
- Contamination: timing terminology is generic; hidden synthetic fan-in graphs, delays, domains and IDs vary. No external or private evaluation data copied.
- Verifier: independent path-enumerating reference, varied DAGs and missing constraints, no-op and targeted mutants, input immutability/byte stability.
adaptation: All contracts, examples, and solvers for this revision are project-authored.
